svg.title: Five item formats, five ways to know an item's length
svg.desc: Each item format of the UAP tells the parser how long the item is: a fixed item has its length in the UAP; a variable item extends while bit 1 of its octets, FX, is set; a repetitive item starts with a count; a compound item starts with a primary subfield whose bits say which subfields follow; an explicit item starts with its own length. Real bytes from the corpus for each.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
